scope: remaining ordinary matched delta seeds and inner table reads only; Spine entries, direct rules and singleton point projections outside these depth curves

off.scope: matched delta seeds; residual solver and compiled merge/marker reads; depth counts bound table atoms including seed; singleton point projections excluded; not native Free Join

on.scope: matched delta seeds; residual solver and compiled merge/marker reads; depth counts bound table atoms including seed; singleton point projections excluded; not native Free Join

fixed_rule_weight_scope: original matched-seed rule weights, restricted to rules still observed in every lane; candidate identity changes; moved queries are not refutations
